Yarn rule sets, November 2026

Each rule set is one yarn for one buyer. Adding a set replaces that yarn's limits.

Rule set: 40s combed, Buyer A

Count (Ne): 39.4 to 40.6. Critical.
CSP: at least 2350. Major.
Twist (TPI): 24 to 26. Minor.
CV%: at most 15. Major.

Rule set: 30s combed, Buyer 2

Count (Ne): 29.6 to 30.4. Critical.
CSP: at least 2250. Major.
Twist (TPI): 21.5 to 23. Minor.
CV%: at most 14. Major.

Rule set: 20s carded, Buyer 1

Count (Ne): 19.5 to 20.5. Critical.
CSP: at least 1950. Major.
Twist (TPI): 17 to 19.5. Minor.
CV%: at most 14. Critical.

General rules

If nobody answers within 5 minutes, alert the backup supervisor.
If nobody answers within 10 minutes, alert the QC manager.
If nobody answers within 20 minutes, alert the plant head.
